name: STAR Method
summary: Results-focused framework that demonstrates impact through concrete examples.
description: A results-focused framework that demonstrates impact through a concrete example: the Situation, the Task you were responsible for, the Actions you took, and the measurable Result. The tone is evidential: every claim is grounded in a specific, verifiable outcome. Best for project reviews, portfolio presentations, and achievement showcases; typical decks run 4-8 slides (case study, customer success story, project retrospective).

beats.name: Situation
beats.description: Describe the context and background of the scenario.
beats.instructions: Describe the relevant context and constraints.

beats.name: Task
beats.description: Explain your specific role and responsibilities in this situation.
beats.instructions: Explain the responsibility or target outcome.

beats.name: Action
beats.description: Detail the specific steps you took to address the challenge.
beats.instructions: Detail the actions taken and choices made.

beats.name: Result
beats.description: Share the measurable outcomes and impact of your actions.
